fullContent:
Changeri Ghrita 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Grahani Rogadhikara 559-561 
 Changeri Ghrita is an Ayurvedic medicine, in herbal ghee form. This medicine has ghee as its base. It balances the kapha and vata doshas. This medicine is used in the treatment of bloating diarrhea, dysuria, piles etc. 
 Ingredients 
 9.6 g of each of:- 
 
 Nagara – ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 Pippalimoola – Long pepper root 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Gajapippali – Scindapsus officinalis 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Pippali – Long pepper fruit 
 Dhanya – Coriander – Coriandrum sativum 
 Bilva – Aegle marmelos 
 Patha – Cyclea peltat/Cissampelos pariera 
 Yavani – Trachyspermum ammi 
 Changeri swarasa – juice extract of Oxalis corniculata – 3.072 l 
 Sarpi – ghee – 768 g 
 Dadhi – curds – 3.072 kg 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The above combination is heated till herbal ghee is prepared. 
 Indications 
 
 Bloating 
 Malabsorption syndrome 
 Diarrhea 
 Dysuria 
 Piles 
 
 Dosage 
 As medicine – quarter to half teaspoon with water, usually before food, once or twice a day, or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects with this medicine. However it is best to use this product under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dosage may result in diarrhea and indigestion. 
 For people having diabetes, high cholesterol, heart diseases and high BP this medicine should be taken only under special care. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
